title: Actual M6 class cache and concrete single-block quality arrays

spec.name: M7.QualityTable.solve_distance
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N), c.1.card = w → c.2.card = w → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.1 → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.2 → M7.Connectivity.connected c → M7.QualityTable.solveDistance c = M7.DefaultQuery.distance c
spec.guidance: Use closed_pointwise to obtain its AnswerCorrect field h.2.2.1. Case split actual solve. For none, its first iff gives f=0 and second iff gives actual quantumDistance=none. For some (d,v,k), its actual result clause gives quantumDistance=some d. Unfold only solveDistance/DefaultQuery.distance/Transport.distance; never unfold actual Q or solve internals. This preserves NoLogical as none; no free AnswerCorrect premise. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.QualityTable.cache_action
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N), c.1.card = w → c.2.card = w → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.1 → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.2 → M7.Connectivity.connected c → ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, (M7.DefaultQuery.dimension (M7.Action.act g c), M7.DefaultQuery.distance (M7.Action.act g c)) = M7.QualityTable.cache c
spec.guidance: For dimension use accepted RecipeSignature.action_signature_degree; DefaultQuery.signature and RecipeSignature.signature are definitionally the same literal full polynomial gcd. For distance use accepted Transport.distance_invariant and solve_distance. cache stores the result of actual solve once for the base. No target placement anchors or canonical-signature-in-E premise; no witness theorem repeated. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.QualityTable.array_scores
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (g : M7.Action.Record N), (M7.QualityTable.leftTable c (g.unit,g.exchange)).size = N ∧ (M7.QualityTable.rightTable c (g.unit,g.exchange)).size = N ∧ M7.QualityTable.placedScores c g = (M7.DefaultQuery.locality (M7.Action.act g c), M7.DefaultQuery.radius (M7.Action.act g c))
spec.guidance: Tables are literal Array.ofFn over Fin N, not arbitrary function-oracle inputs. Use Array.size_ofFn and Array.getElem_ofFn; getElem? is some under ZMod.val_lt, then ZMod.natCast_zmod_val turns the indexed natural position back into the actual shift. leftImage/rightImage at outer=(g.unit,g.exchange) and g shifts are definitionally the two act supports. Unfold locality/radius as sum/max of blockScores. Array lengths supply the exact 2N table-entry accounting. Includes N=1 and empty supports. Return tactic lines without leading by.
